findings.reason: the plan must state that the G-EQDSK is delivered to the reader under a supported suffix (a `.geqdsk`-named copy on reachable storage, which the plan's "nothing runs on the JT-60SA server" already forces) or name the content-sniffing path, otherwise the implementation node meets a confusing format error on the plan's own named input.
findings.text: the changed unit says E101011's G-EQDSK "is read through the `eqdsk` package's `EQDSKInterface`", but that class's public entry point `EQDSKInterface.from_file` selects its parser by the file's suffix and accepts only `.eqdsk`, `.eqdsk_out`, `.geqdsk` or `.json` (`eqdsk/file.py` `EQDSK_EXTENSIONS`); the file §7 names is `/home/d240034/fbequ/EFIT95.DATA`, whose `.DATA` suffix makes `from_file` raise `ValueError: Unrecognised file format '.DATA'`. The only extension-agnostic reader in the package is the private `eqdsk.file._read_eqdsk`, and `convert_eqdsk` takes an already-parsed object rather than a path, so no public path reads the named file as written. This is the census for its type: §7 is the plan's only citation of an eqdsk reader (grep over the snapshot finds `EQDSKInterface` at :917 alone), and no ambix module reads a G-EQDSK today (grep of `imas_ambix/`, `packages/`, `tests/`, `scripts/` for `eqdsk|geqdsk|EQDSKInterface` returns nothing), so this is the single site of the defect.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the change adds no ambix module; the format read is delegated to the external `eqdsk` package and injected through the existing `read_efit_geometry(loader=...)` seam, which is an interface smaller than what it hides.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — no second G-EQDSK reader exists in ambix (`imas_ambix/`, `packages/`, `tests/`, `scripts/` carry zero EQDSK readers), and the `eqdsk` package's file-COCOS handling is not the same concern as the DD-path COCOS resolver (`_target_cocos_transformation`) the plan already owns in `packages/imas-alambic/src/imas_alambic/transform_engine.py`.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; the changed unit adds to none of the four families, and its own text states what it adds no public definition for ("writes no G-EQDSK reader of its own… the reader adds no public definition to ambix") and why it adds nothing beyond a `pyproject.toml` direct-dependency declaration.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — §7 cites the `eqdsk` package's `EQDSKInterface` as the reader for E101011's G-EQDSK, but that reader dispatches on file extension and rejects the plan's named file `EFIT95.DATA`.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — §7 writes no G-EQDSK reader of its own and no wrapper over one; it reuses the package's `EQDSKInterface` and the seam's existing `loader` argument, and says so.
